subject: Operational pillars monthly checkpoint: June metrics & owner commitments
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Beth Carter <beth@dataforge.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Operational pillars monthly checkpoint: June metrics & owner commitments

Team — attaching the June operational pillars export and the draft QBR deck link (see related links). High level callouts: 

- Latency: 95th P95 latency increased ~12% in EU region vs May (primarily 2 long tail spikes tied to sequence-length distribution).
- Cost: unit inference cost (per 1M tokens) up ~8% month-over-month, model-mix driven (more customers on higher-capacity checkpoints).
- Uptime: regional uptime still ~99.95%% for the month; two incidents (see incidents log) contributed ~30m of impact in EU-West.
- Usage: overall customer token usage +22%% M/M; peak concurrency set a new median.

Immediate asks and owners: 
- Markus: investigate kernel perf regression in EU (deep perf run + repro for single-model workload). Target: initial findings by Thu EOD (2027-06-10).
- Marissa: confirm Dedicated capacity commit changes for affected customers and whether we can backfill burst pools for next 2 weeks. Target: Wed EOD (2027-06-09).
- Sean: I'll consolidate these notes into the QBR deck and send to Beth for pre-read; need slot confirmation for external QBR.

Attachments: pillars-june-2027.csv (export), qbr-prep-deck-v2.pdf (draft)

Quick proposed owner-level bullets for the QBR appendix (to include in the deck):
1) Short-term mitigations (canary parameter changes, KV cache tuning) — owner Markus
2) Cost playbook items (quantization profiles, routing by cost tier) — owner Marissa
3) SLA remediation commitments and timeline — owner Sean

Please reply with any changes to owners or timing. If you see additional context from support/customer threads that should be included, paste a brief note.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---
(Attachment stubs: pillars-june-2027.csv (text/csv), qbr-prep-deck-v2.pdf (application/pdf))

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational pillars monthly checkpoint: June metrics & owner commitments

Sean — thanks for the summary, looks right from the infra side. Quick notes and next steps: 

> - I will kick off a focused perf repro for the EU regression this afternoon (long-sequence workload, mixed precision).
> - Adding a trace-level capture for the two incident windows and shipping the service-incidents-log.txt to the thread.

Immediate plan:
- Today: perf repro job + trace capture (ETA: 6 hours).
- Wed: reproduce locally and validate whether kernel selection or batch scheduling change caused the tail.
- Thu: short mitigation run (fallback kernel & tighter batching window) to test reduction in P95 tail.

Also discovered a small telemetry gap where sequence-length bucketing misclassified ~3%% of requests — I will include a short note in the incidents log and a pointer to the heatmap in the drive link.

Attachments: service-incidents-log.txt (plain text)

I'll post updates to the thread as I have them. If anyone wants the perf job parameters early, tell me and I'll share the script.

— Markus
Director, Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -0700

Got it — appreciate the clarity. A couple follow-ups from the capacity/finance side: 

- Capacity: I can confirm we have two weeks of burst budget to apply to EU-West while Markus validates the regression. I'll propose specific pool sizes by EOD today.
- Cost/OKR note: given the cost uptick + higher usage, I propose we map a short-term OKR adjustment for Q3 to reduce unit cost by 6%% via routing + quantization. Draft OKR line below: 
  - Objective: Restore unit economics while preserving SLAs
  - Key Result 1: Reduce average unit cost by 6%% vs July baseline (owner: Marissa)
  - Key Result 2: Reduce P95 latency tail by 15%% in EU (owner: Markus)

- QBR logistics: I prefer we include two appendix slides: (1) incident timeline + remediation, (2) cost impact by customer cohort. I can prepare those slides if Sean confirms.

Thanks — will send the capacity numbers shortly.

Marissa Cole
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
